_doc: WINSLOW dating cabinet (#28, Wave D, built 2026-07-17-eve; roster #34). Poul Winsløw (b. ~1952): Preben Holm's head-assistant 1967-1985, own brand from the 1985 Holm closure. THE CLIFF SET = the mid-1990s stamp change (old block/oval name + ONE silver dot -> new fancy-pipe symbol + TWO dots), documented as already done in Jan Andersson's May-1997 profile. SOURCES: staging/pipedia/Winslow.json (Andersson 1997) + Preben_Holm.json (autobiography corroborates the 1967 hire: 'engaged 16 years ago when he was 16/17' written 1983) + artisan registry. Registry career fix 2026-07-17: Holm-era start corrected 1975->1967 per both articles.

history_anchors._doc: 1967: Poul (17) answers Preben Holm's apprentice advertisement; becomes head-assistant/foreman (Holm kept 1/3 salary during his military service to hold him). 1985: returns from vacation to find the Holm factory CLOSED -> builds his own workshop at his house in Hvidovre (south Copenhagen) -> WINSLOW brand floor 1985. Early years tough; Stanwell helps (exhibition demos abroad — ties to stanwell.json Winslow years). By 1997: 2 assistants, ~900 pipes/yr. CROWN series started 'some years ago' before 1997 (cheaper line, NOT seconds: less-dense-grain briar, preformed-then-finished acrylic mouthpiece vs hand-cut). Style: colourful; inlays of boxwood, acrylic, silver, laburnum. Every pipe ships with a handmade wooden tamper + black leather pouch.

brand_marks.physical: OLD pipes (1985 to mid-90s): 'WINSLÖW' in big block letters OR in an oval; ONE silver stem-dot (rarely THREE in a triangle). NEW pipes (mid-90s+): fancy-pipe symbol + WINSLÖW in small block letters; always TWO dots, one bigger than the other. Grades: P.C. (Private Collection) top, then A-E descending (A best). All Corsican briar. Crown: own series stamp + grade numbers (e.g. Crown 300).

line_years._notes: crown: 'some years ago' before the May-1997 article -> floor ~1990 with slack = [1988,...], approx flagged. Harlequin = limited editions (undated). NOT encoded: grade letters (A-E span the whole brand), P.C./Private Collection (spans).
